data.description: Yas Island offers an unparalleled blend of excitement and relaxation for visitors of all ages.

data.answer:
The Yas Island community embodies a luxurious and vibrant lifestyle, offering residents an unparalleled blend of entertainment, leisure, and sophistication. Nestled amidst pristine beaches and lush greenery, this exclusive enclave exudes a sense of tranquility and opulence. Residents enjoy access to world-class amenities, including private beach clubs, championship golf courses, and upscale shopping destinations.

The vibrant dining scene offers a diverse array of culinary delights, from fine dining restaurants overlooking the marina to trendy cafes and bistros lining the waterfront promenade. With an exciting calendar of events and activities, including concerts, festivals, and sporting events, the Yas Island community fosters a dynamic social scene and a sense of belonging, making it a coveted destination for those seeking an elevated lifestyle in the heart of Abu Dhabi.

Yas Island comprises several distinct sub-communities, each offering its unique lifestyle and amenities. Yas Acres presents a master-planned community with villas and townhouses amidst landscaped parks, while West Yas offers luxurious waterfront living with spacious villas and family-friendly amenities.

Yas Village, situated in the island's heart, provides a mix of residential and commercial properties, promoting a vibrant urban lifestyle. Ansam, a premier residential development, features luxury apartments overlooking the Yas Links Golf Course, complete with exclusive amenities. Together, these sub-communities contribute to Yas Island's diverse and thriving lifestyle offerings, catering to residents seeking luxury, convenience, and a strong sense of community.

Water Edge Yas Island is a vibrant waterfront residential development located on Yas Island, offering a unique blend of contemporary living and natural beauty. Situated along the serene waterfront promenade, Water's Edge features modern apartments with stunning views of the marina and lush green landscapes.

Off-Plan Projects in Yas Island

When it comes to Off-Plan Trends in Yas Island, there are many properties under development. Some of the off-plan projects in Yas Island include Water’s Edge Yas Island which consists of studio to 3-bedroom apartments.

Yas Golf Collection Residences is another highly anticipated project that features studio to 3-bedroom apartments. There are many amenities in the area, including a swimming pool, a gym, and an Aqua Lounge.

Investors can also consider Gardenia Bay in Yas Island. A project by Aldar Properties provides residents with an unmatched waterfront experience.

Renting a Property in Yas Island Abu Dhabi

Rental Trends in Yas Island show that the properties for rent in Yas Island are gaining popularity. Studios for lease on Yas Island start from AED 28k, while 1-bedroom apartments are available for a starting price of AED 49k.

Similarly, 2-bedroom units are priced minimum AED 72k per year, with 3-bedroom apartments available for AED 100k per annum. Finally, 4-bedroom apartments are listed at rents starting from AED 350k.

For those exploring villas on Yas Island, a variety of bed types and amenities are available. 2-bedroom villas are offered at rates of at least AED 175k, while 3-bedroom villas begin at AED 210k  annually. Rent for 4-bedroom villas begin at AED 230k, while 5-bedroom villas start at AED 265k, yearly.

Additionally, 2-bedroom townhouses can be leased for AED 180k minimum, while 3-bedroom options start from AED 225k. Rent for 4-bedroom townhouses starts from AED 255k.

Yas Island Properties for Sale

Want to know about the sale trends in Yas Island? Studios available for purchase in Yas Island range from AED 470k to AED 1.3M, while 1-bedroom apartments can be acquired for AED 518k to AED 2.3M. 2-bedroom flats for sale are priced between AED 735k and AED 3.8M, with 3-bedroom apartments ranging from AED 1.05M to AED 9M. Meanwhile, 4-bedroom flats are listed at prices ranging from AED 1.59M to AED 7.5M, and 5-bedroom flats are priced at AED 3.0 M.

For those interested in villa options, 2-bedroom villas in Yas Island are available for sale between AED 1.73M and AED 4M, while 3-bedroom villas are priced from AED 1.99M to AED 8.0 M. Spacious 4-bedroom villas start from AED 2.6M and go up to AED 12M. Purchasing a 5-bedroom villa costs approximately AED 3.5M to AED 17M, while 6-bedroom villas range from AED 5.2M to AED 19 M. Additionally, 7-bedroom villas are available for purchase, priced between AED 8.0M and AED 14M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Yas Island?

data.answer:
Life in Yas Island is characterized by a perfect blend of luxury, leisure, and excitement. Residents and visitors alike enjoy unparalleled access to world-class entertainment venues, pristine beaches, Yas Island water park, Yas Island theme parks, and upscale amenities.

From thrilling theme parks and championship golf courses to exclusive shopping malls and fine dining restaurants, Yas Island offers a vibrant and dynamic lifestyle against the backdrop of stunning waterfront vistas. Whether indulging in adrenaline-fueled adventures or simply unwinding in the lap of luxury, Yas Island provides an extraordinary living experience that appeals to all.

Public Transportation in Yas Island

Public Transportation in Yas Island: Yas Island benefits from convenient public transportation options, with the Yas Express shuttle service providing easy connectivity to key attractions and hotels within the island. Additionally, the upcoming extension of the Abu Dhabi Metro network to Yas Island promises enhanced connectivity to the mainland and beyond. With frequent shuttle services and future metro access, residents and visitors can enjoy efficient and hassle-free transportation around the island. 

If you are coming from Dubai via public transportation, the cheapest way is to take a bus from the Dubai Al Ghubaiba Bus Station to the Abu Dhabi Bus Station, then transfer to the 102 Bus Route heading to Yas Island.

Supermarkets in Yas Island

Supermarkets in Yas Island: Residents of Yas Island have easy access to several supermarkets catering to their daily needs. Spinneys and Waitrose are conveniently located within a 10-minute drive, offering a wide range of groceries, fresh produce, and household essentials. With ample parking and a diverse selection of products, these supermarkets ensure residents have convenient shopping options close to home.

Shopping Malls Near Yas Island

Yas Island residents are within easy reach of several prominent shopping malls in Abu Dhabi. Yas Mall, the island's premier retail destination, is just a short 5-minute drive away, boasting a vast array of international brands, dining options, and entertainment facilities. Additionally, Marina Mall and Abu Dhabi Mall are both accessible within a 20-minute drive, providing residents with even more shopping and leisure options in the nearby city.

Schools and Nurseries in Yas Island

Schools and Nurseries in Yas Island: Families residing on Yas Island have access to a variety of educational institutions catering to children of all ages. The British School Al Khubairat and Cranleigh Abu Dhabi are prestigious international schools located within a 15-minute drive, offering high-quality British curriculum education. For younger children, there are several nurseries nearby, including Hummingbird Nursery and Odyssey Nursery, ensuring families have convenient options for their children's early education needs.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Yas Island

Yas Island offers easy access to various places of worship, ensuring religious diversity and inclusivity for residents and visitors. Within a 15-minute drive, individuals can find the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, an iconic landmark known for its stunning architecture and cultural significance. Additionally, St. Joseph's Cathedral and St. Andrew's Church provide Catholic and Protestant congregations, respectively, within a 20-minute drive. For those of other faiths, Hindu temples and Sikh gurdwaras are located in the nearby city of Abu Dhabi, accessible within a 25-minute drive from Yas Island.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Yas Island

Residents of Yas Island have access to a range of healthcare facilities within proximity. Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, a world-renowned medical center offering advanced healthcare services, is conveniently located within a 15-minute drive. Additionally, Burjeel Medical City and NMC Royal Hospital are accessible within a 20-minute drive, providing comprehensive medical care and emergency services to residents and visitors of Yas Island.

Yas Island Abu Dhabi Location & Nearby Areas

Situated off the coast of Abu Dhabi, Yas Island enjoys a prime location within proximity to various key areas in Abu Dhabi. The island is conveniently accessible via the Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan Highway, with driving times to nearby attractions as follows: Yas Mall, the island's premier retail destination, is just a short 5-minute drive away, while Ferrari World Abu Dhabi and Yas Waterworld are accessible within 10 minutes. Furthermore, Abu Dhabi International Airport is located approximately 10 minutes away, providing convenient air travel options for residents and visitors.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Yas Island

data.answer:
There are many things to do on the exotic island. The Yas Island theme parks, Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, Yas Waterworld, Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi, and SeaWorld Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, are extremely popular among residents and visitors alike. Yas Beach provides a serene escape with its pristine sands and turquoise waters, while Yas Links Abu Dhabi offers a challenging round of golf amidst stunning coastal scenery.

Yas Island Restaurants & Bars

Yas Island boasts a diverse culinary scene, with a variety of restaurants and bars offering tantalizing flavors from around the world. Visitors can indulge in fine dining experiences at renowned establishments such as Cipriani and Toro Toro, or enjoy casual bites and refreshing drinks at beachfront venues like Iris Yas Island and Stars N Bars. With options ranging from gourmet cuisine to laid-back lounges, there's something to satisfy every palate on Yas Island.

Beaches Near Yas Island

Yas Island is surrounded by picturesque beaches where visitors can soak up the sun and enjoy the tranquil waters of the Arabian Gulf. Yas Beach, located just a 10-minute drive away, offers pristine sands, crystal-clear waters, and a range of water sports activities for all ages to enjoy. Additionally, Saadiyat Public Beach and Corniche Beach are within a 20-minute drive, providing further options for beachgoers looking to relax and unwind amidst stunning coastal landscapes.

Hotels Near Yas Island

Yas Island is home to several world-class hotels, each offering luxurious accommodations and a host of amenities for guests to enjoy. Staybridge Suites Abu Dhabi - Yas Island, an IHG Hotel, Yas Island Rotana, Crowne Plaza Yas Island, and Rixos Yas Island are among the top hotels in Yas Island, offering unparalleled comfort, convenience, and hospitality. Whether guests are seeking a relaxing retreat or an action-packed adventure, these hotels provide the perfect base for exploring all that Yas Island has to offer.

Attractions and Landmarks in and Near Yas Island

Yas Island is brimming with attractions and landmarks that promise unforgettable experiences for residents and visitors alike. Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, located just minutes away, is a haven for speed enthusiasts with its thrilling rides and immersive exhibitions celebrating the iconic Italian brand.

Nearby, Yas Waterworld offers a refreshing escape with its array of water slides, wave pools, and lazy rivers, perfect for cooling off on hot days. Additionally, the Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi theme park offers a whimsical journey into the world of iconic characters such as Batman, Superman, and Wonder Woman, all within easy reach of Yas Island. You can also explore the region's first marine life theme park at Yas Island SeaWorld. Yas Island indoor skydiving is another excellent activity to take part in the area.

For motorsport fans, Yas Marina Circuit hosts the Formula 1 Etihad Airways Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, while the Yas Marina offers picturesque views of luxury yachts and waterfront dining options.

A disadvantage of living in Yas Island is the relatively limited availability of public transportation options, which can make commuting to other parts of Abu Dhabi or neighboring areas less convenient for residents who rely on public transit.

What are the main attractions on Yas Island?

Yas Island is home to several iconic attractions, including Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, Yas Waterworld, Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi, and Yas Marina Circuit, where the Formula 1 Etihad Airways Abu Dhabi Grand Prix is held.

What dining options are available on Yas Island?

Yas Island offers a diverse culinary scene with a variety of restaurants and cafes catering to different tastes and preferences. Visitors can enjoy everything from fine dining establishments serving international cuisine to casual eateries and beachfront lounges.

Are there accommodations available on Yas Island?

Yes, Yas Island features a range of luxury hotels and resorts, including Yas Island Rotana, Crowne Plaza Yas Island, and Rixos Yas Island, providing guests with comfortable accommodations and convenient access to the island's attractions.

How do I get to Yas Island from Abu Dhabi or Dubai?

Yas Island is easily accessible by car via the Sheikh Khalifa Highway from both Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Additionally, public transportation options such as buses and taxis are available for those without private transportation.

data.content:
Yas Island, situated off the coast of Abu Dhabi, is a dynamic entertainment and leisure destination that captivates visitors with its diverse attractions and luxurious offerings. Spanning over 25 square kilometers, this man-made island is renowned for its world-class entertainment venues, pristine beaches, and upscale hotels.

It boasts a range of luxurious properties and amenities designed to elevate the residential experience, from high-rise waterfront apartments with breathtaking views to spacious villas nestled within lush green landscapes. Residents of Yas Island enjoy access to an array of premium amenities, including private beach clubs, state-of-the-art fitness centers, and serene spa retreats.

Yas Island benefits from a well-developed road network that ensures seamless connectivity to Abu Dhabi and beyond. The island is linked to the mainland by several bridges, including the iconic Sheikh Khalifa Bridge, which provides easy access to the city center and Abu Dhabi International Airport.

nodes.title: Yas Park Place
nodes.about:
Yas Park Place on Yas Island is a distinctive residential development by Aldar Properties, featuring six elegant towers rising across 11 floors. With 780 thoughtfully designed residences, the development offers studios, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive 2-bedroom duplexes, crafted for modern island living and strong long-term capital appreciation. The units can be booked with just a 5% down payment.

Yas Park Place by Aldar Properties reflects a lifestyle shaped by nature, energy, and everyday discovery. Surrounded by landscaped gardens and moments from the waterfront, the community integrates multiple pools, wellness-focused spaces, outdoor cinema experiences, and vibrant retail and dining, creating a setting where daily life feels elevated and immersive.

nodes.title: Manchester City Residence
nodes.about:
Manchester City Yas Residences is a canal-facing luxury community located on Yas Island, Abu Dhabi’s most iconic lifestyle and sports destination. These branded residences are developed by Ohana Development in partnership with the globally recognized football club, Manchester City.  

The project features 1 to 5-bedroom apartments, penthouses, villas, and mansions. Designed around space, privacy, and waterfront living, the units are available with a highly flexible payment plan, making it the lowest entry point project of this stature.

Manchester City Residences Yas Island emphasizes modern minimalist architecture, expansive green corridors, and waterfront living. Residents benefit from parks, landscaped walkways, and jogging and cycling paths, while the strong global branding and Yas Island’s growth trajectory support long-term capital appreciation potential.

nodes.title: Stellar by Elie Saab
nodes.about:
Stellar by Elie Saab at Yas Bay, Yas Island, is an 18-storey landmark developed by Emirates Developments. This exclusive address features 144 beautifully designed residences that embody the sophistication and timeless aesthetic of Elie Saab. Each space is crafted with precision, blending modern architecture with luxury interiors to create a truly distinctive living experience.

The project includes an elegant collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, 3 and 4-bedroom garden villas, and 4-bedroom penthouses. With its waterfront setting and a host of premium lifestyle amenities, such as a pool, fitness center, cinema, and residents’ lounge, Stellar by Elie Saab offers both comfort and investment appeal. These residences stand out as prime Elie Saab branded real estate on Yas Island, promising strong ROI potential in one of Abu Dhabi’s most dynamic locations.

nodes.title: Al Deem
nodes.about:
Al Deem by Aldar is a vibrant master community northeast of Yas Island, combining elegant design with purposeful living. Offering 3 and 4-bedroom live-work townhouses, the development balances private family spaces with integrated work environments, meeting the needs of today’s modern households.

The community’s appeal lies in its carefully curated lifestyle. From equestrian and sports facilities to cycling-friendly pathways, every detail enhances well-being and connection. Positioned close to major highways, Al Deem at Yas Island offers both tranquility and accessibility, making it an attractive choice for end-users and investors alike.

nodes.title: Sama Yas
nodes.about:
Sama Yas by Aldar Properties is a premium residential development in Yas Park, Abu Dhabi, offering an exceptional collection of 1, 2  and 3 bedroom apartments, duplexes, garden apartments, and three exclusive penthouses. Designed for those seeking a balance of luxury and nature, this masterfully planned community immerses residents in a serene, verdant setting with seamless access to leisure and wellness facilities. Comprising 3 eight-level buildings, Sama Yas redefines modern living with sustainable, smart, and innovative interiors.

Renowned Chef Izu curates the elegant kitchen spaces, while the meticulous craftsmanship of Woods Bagot, Mustard & Linen brings a refined aesthetic to the interiors. The development aims to achieve Estidama 3 Pearl, Fitwel, and LEED Gold Certification, ensuring an eco-friendly and energy-efficient lifestyle. Sama Yas offers world-class amenities, including a boutique spa, concierge services, co-working spaces, a multipurpose lounge, and a theatre room. Fitness enthusiasts can enjoy a fully equipped gym, cycling and running tracks, outdoor work pods, and recreational areas. Nestled in Yas Island’s vibrant hub, this stunning community delivers the perfect blend of sustainability, luxury, and modern convenience.

nodes.title: The Icon Tower
nodes.about: The Icon Tower - embodying the elegance of modern luxury, the ICON Residences seamlessly combine the ethos of Yas Island with avant-garde architecture. Drawing inspiration from the azure waters of the Arabian Gulf and the legacy of Abu Dhabi’s urban charm, the building's silhouette is a mesmerizing dance of continuous, fluid lines.
